notes:
Research notes (as of Monday, Oct 12, 2026). No place was given, and "football" could mean soccer or American football, so both are covered. The GOAT question is a matter of opinion, so these notes report where the sources land.

**Soccer (association football)**
- Most sources point to Lionel Messi. A Yahoo Sports piece from about three months ago says the majority of football fans believe Messi is the greatest football player ever, but Ronaldo's passionate supporters refuse to accept this.
- The Week (last updated 1 September 2026) says that after the 2026 World Cup Messi "has established himself as the undisputed greatest".
- Messi's numbers: eight Ballons d'Or, six European Golden Shoes, and named the world's best player by FIFA eight times. He retired from the Argentina national team in 2026 after 21 years.
- Reuters, as cited by The Sports Encounter, reports that at the 2026 World Cup Messi became the tournament's all-time leading scorer with 18 goals. The same source says Cristiano Ronaldo became the first player to score in six different World Cups.
- Squawka's analysis (about four months old) concludes Ronaldo is one of the three greatest players ever, but Messi is the greatest.
- The debate is not settled. Ronaldo is still named as a top-tier case, as the greatest goalscorer. Pelé is also named in the all-time debate, and one source lists five names that dominate it.

**American football (NFL)**
- Most sources point to Tom Brady. A February 2026 ranking says it would feel wrong to give the honor of best NFL player of all time to anyone other than Tom Brady.
- Brady's numbers: a record seven championships and the most Super Bowl MVPs in NFL history, at five. He also won 3 NFL MVP awards (2007, 2010 and 2017).
- Jerry Rice is the usual alternative. A February 2026 report says Brady himself said "Jerry Rice is still the GOAT". The same ranking puts Rice second, with Lawrence Taylor third.
- Some sources are older. The CBS Sports and NFL.com pieces are several years old, and Al Jazeera's report on Brady's retirement is from 2023.
